definitions.explanation: The period of time after classes end for the day. Specifically refers to the time after school dismissal, typically used in the context of elementary through high school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}に{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: I hung out with friends after school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}は{部活|ぶかつ}の{練習|れんしゅう}がある。
examples.english: I have club practice after school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}の{教室|きょうしつ}に{残|のこ}って、{先生|せんせい}に{質問|しつもん}した。
examples.english: I stayed in the classroom after school and asked the teacher a question.

notes:
USAGE:
{放課後|ほうかご} specifically refers to the period after school classes end. It is primarily associated with elementary, middle, and high school contexts — not typically used for university. A culturally significant time in Japanese school life, as many students participate in {部活動|ぶかつどう} (club activities) during this period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放課後|ほうかご}の{教室|きょうしつ}: the classroom after school
- {放課後|ほうかご}に{残|のこ}る: to stay after school
- {放課後|ほうかご}の{活動|かつどう}: after-school activities
